name: photo-magic
description: One-sentence photo retoucher powered by local AI image-to-image on Intel AIPC

displayDescription.en: One-sentence photo retoucher driven by local AI image-to-image. Swap backgrounds, remove watermarks, change ID-photo background colors, and clean up clutter in seconds.
displayDescription.zh: 一句话修图管家，本地 AI 图生图驱动，换背景、去水印、证件照换底色、去杂物，几秒输出专业级效果。
